supported_new_facts.statement: The REAL ID Act sets minimum security standards for state-issued driver licenses and identification cards.
Federal agencies cannot accept a state driver license or identification card for official purposes when the issuing state does not meet the REAL ID security standards.
The Star Card is an Idaho driver license or identification card marked with a star to show compliance with federal REAL ID security standards.
Obtaining an Idaho Star Card is optional.
The documents required for a driver training permit are the same documents required for a driver license application.
